content: यम् €1 <ab>P.</ab> (यच्छति, ययाम, अयंसीत्, यंस्यति, यन्तुम्, यत; {%<ab>desid.</ab>%} यियंसति) .²1 To check, curb, restrain, control, subdue, stop, suppress; यच्छेद् वाङ्मनसी प्रज्ञः <ls>Kaṭh.</ls>; यतचित्तात्मन् <ls>Bg. 4. 21</ls>; see यत. .²2 To offer, give, bestow. .²3 <ab>Ved.</ab> To support, sustain. .²4 To raise, lift up. .²5 To extend, stretch. .²6 To go. .²7 To exhibit, show. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (यमयति-ते) To restrain, check <ab>&c.</ab>
